item.title: Is Nikon About to Crack Down on Viltrox Z-Mount Lenses?
item.description: In an unlikely turn of events, the Chinese social media has revealed that Nikon has filed a lawsuit against Viltrox in China. While the company has not made a public statement yet, court records on Chinese litigation sites reveal a legal proceeding that could lead to a block on Viltrox lenses for Nikon Z-mount cameras. So, what has caused this row and what could it mean for photographers? Here's a look.

item.title: Is Cosina Developing a Portrait Photography Lover’s Dream Lens?
item.description: Last year, Voigtlander's Cosina launched a new lens that helps control bokeh in pictures. The company has since been trying to introduce options that offer something for everyone, including APS-C lenses. It now appears that Cosina is working on a new patent that could help photographers achieve extra bokeh. Here is a look at what the patent offers and what it could mean.

item.title: Is This New Viltrox Adapter the Future of Manual Lenses?
item.description: Viltrox has been known for its budget lenses, which many young photographers depend on. However, while the company is creating more optics, according to a new report, it is also working on a unique lens adapter: the NexusFocus F1. The latter is designed to give cinema creators an easy way to work with vintage lenses. What it entails, and whether it is considered a breakthrough, let us get into that in a bit.
